draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.73, the 4th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 1st of 13 at RB. He went 3rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jahmyr Gibbs. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (96th percentile). College production: his final season (2025) ranked 2nd in rushing yards among the 13 RBs in his class with stats.
